message.content:
This editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover. Centered at the top, the title "TEMPO" is printed in large white capital letters. Overlapping the "M" and "P" is an illustration of a tall, grey metal electrical pylon. The pylon appears to be disintegrating or collapsing, with its lower steel beams falling away as detached, straight grey lines. Clinging to the upper-left side of the pylon is a man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a light-brown long-sleeved shirt and dark trousers. He is positioned mid-climb, with one hand gripping a beam and one leg hooked over another. 

Large black text to the right of the falling beams reads "DAHLAN RISKAN." Below this, smaller black text states: "Menerobos aturan administrasi, mantan Direktur Utama PLN itu menjadi tersangka korupsi. Mengapa ia dibidik?" 

Additional text at the top includes "INVESTIGASI: JALUR TIKUS PENGEDAR NARKOTIK" and "KEJANGGALAN-KEJANGGALAN KASUS ANGELINE," flanking a small circular inset photograph of a child's face. The bottom left contains "RP 39.500," a barcode, and publication details. The background is a pale blue gradient.
